title: The New Restaurant at the Public Theater Revives the Astor Family Name
partialText: The NoHo Hospitality Group reimagines the dining room at the Public Theater, Lana Lagomarsini serves up tasting menus at Creola and more food news.

title: Two Chinese Firms Used Binance to Launder Iranian Oil Money, US Says
partialText: Federal prosecutors said proceeds from the sale of Iranian oil flowed through Binance, the world’s largest crypto exchange, to finance terrorism.

title: With Emmys Haul, Apple Joins the Big Leagues of TV
partialText: The tech giant took home the most trophies this year, breaking the chokehold HBO and Netflix have had on the awards for more than two decades.

title: Congress Has Proposed Many Bills for A.I. Regulation. Lawmakers Have Enacted Few.

title: Bessent Defends Faltering Bond Market Intervention
partialText: Testifying before Congress, the Treasury secretary said that he supported giving Americans $5,000 dividends if Republicans win in November.

partialText: The 10-year Treasury yield breached levels last seen in 2007, with intensifying worries about energy-driven inflation contributing to bond investors’ angst.

title: Carney Pitches Canada as a Haven of Investment Stability in a Chaotic World
partialText: Prime Minister Mark Carney brought together in Toronto about 100 money managers overseeing much of the world’s wealth to promote Canada as an ideal place to invest.

partialText: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates on Wednesday, putting Kevin M. Warsh, the chairman, at odds with the administration just before the midterms.

partialText: Groups are preparing thousands of observers for midterm elections in November. Some volunteers are being conditioned to expect bad behavior.

title: Architects of Japan’s Easy-Money Policies Are Changing Their Minds

title: U.S. Imposes Sanctions on Russia’s VTB Bank Over Ties to Iran
partialText: The move, which targeted a bank that is already under U.S. sanctions, was part of the Trump administration’s Operation Economic Outcast initiative.

title: What Is Driving Diesel Prices Up? Energy Chaos Caused by Two Wars.

title: Bond Market Rebukes Bessent by Sending Borrowing Costs Ever Higher
partialText: The Treasury secretary had dared “Bloomberg terminal bros” to bet against him and they did.

title: Amazon Suspends Flights With Airline Whose Plane Crashed in Miami

title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Touches 5%, Highest Level in Years

title: Trump Administration Moves to Integrate A.I. Into Medical Care Despite Concerns
partialText: Federal projects are rolling out A.I. agents that offer therapy and prescribe medicine, raising concerns about safety and the influence of venture capital investors.

title: Money Is Flowing Into Space Start-Ups. Some Investors See a SpaceX Effect.
partialText: Open Cosmos, a European satellite maker, has raised about $346 million, part of a wave of recent funding deals in the space sector.

partialText: Today’s chatbots aren’t likely to help lone actors invent a deadly pathogen, experts say. But newer models, trained in biology, may need stronger safeguards.

title: Why Is Danny Meyer, the Happy Face of Hospitality, Serving Up Regrets?

title: Defense Hiring Will Ease, Not End, Pain in European Car Industry

title: Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan Walks a Tricky Line on Tariffs as He Seeks Re-Election

title: The Bari Weiss Era of ‘60 Minutes’ Begins

title: Trump Promises to Lift Tariffs on Irish Whiskey After Appeals
partialText: President Trump’s decision, announced while visiting his golf course in Ireland, was the latest shift in his trade policies.

title: Trump Blames Ukraine for Global Diesel Shortage

partialText: As a rout in the bond market deepens, the pressure grows on Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to restore calm.
